_meta.description: MOCK seasonal outbreak calendar for the Smart Pest Detection & Prediction System. Maps each damaging pest to the months it typically peaks in Sri Lanka, plus the temperature/humidity conditions that favour it. Keys match knowledge_base/pests.json. This is plausible demonstration data aligned to Sri Lanka's two cropping seasons (Maha: Sep/Oct-Mar, wetter NE monsoon; Yala: Apr/May-Aug, SW monsoon) and general IPM knowledge. It is NOT validated field data and should be replaced with real historical pest records when available. Months are 1=January..12=December.

brown_planthopper.driver: Warm, humid, densely-planted and over-fertilised paddy in late Maha.

leafhopper.driver: Wet, warm paddy conditions; spreads tungro virus in early Maha.

rice_stem_borer.driver: Overlapping paddy stages across both seasons let moths breed continuously.

snail.driver: Flooded paddy at establishment after monsoon rains; golden apple snail thrives.

slug.driver: Cool, damp, humid nights during the NE monsoon.

caterpillar.driver: Moth flights at the start of each season produce caterpillar generations.

moth.driver: Adult moth flights precede caterpillar outbreaks; watch light traps.

fall_armyworm.driver: Warm weather and young maize whorls; a fast-spreading migratory pest.

grasshopper.driver: Hot, dry Yala weather and grassy field margins favour breeding.

thrips.driver: Hot, dry, water-stressed crops (chili, onion); also spreads viruses.

mealybug.driver: Warm, dry conditions and ant activity build cottony colonies.

fruit_fly.driver: Mango, guava and cucurbit fruiting season with warm, humid weather.

beetle.driver: Warming early-Yala weather brings out leaf-feeding beetles and grubs.

weevil.driver: Post-harvest grain storage and warm, humid stores favour weevil buildup.

ants.driver: Dry weather drives ants to farm aphids and mealybugs for honeydew.

earwig.driver: Cool, damp conditions bring earwigs to seedlings at night.
